info.title: Vulnify API
info.description: Public machine contract for AI agents. Send an API key as `Authorization: Bearer vln_live_...` or `X-API-Key` (the same secret; not a JWT). POST /v1/events decides an action; GET /v1/events/{id} returns that same body, including finalDecision, quotaExceeded and sandbox. Contract v1.

tags.name: Machine API
tags.description: Called by agents with an API key (Bearer vln_live_... / vln_test_... or X-API-Key). Contract v1.

post.summary: Decide an agent action before it runs

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retries with the same key (per organization and endpoint) return the stored decision instead of deciding again.

schema.description: agent or agentId is required unless the API key is bound to an agent. resource or resourceId is required.

agent.description: Agent name as registered in Vulnify.

resource.description: Resource name as registered in Vulnify.

content.description: Optional text scanned for sensitive data. Scanned in memory and never stored.

200.description: Decision: { id, decision, finalDecision, evaluatedDecision, monitored, riskLevel, riskScore, reasons, policy, dlpFindings, lgpdCategories, review, quotaExceeded, sandbox }. decision is the stored outcome and does not change when a review is resolved. finalDecision is the effective outcome (ALLOW after approval, BLOCK after denial or expiry, REVIEW while pending). quotaExceeded flags a plan overrun without blocking; sandbox is true for TEST keys.

X-Request-Id.description: Request id for support and log correlation (a caller-sent plain id is kept).

Idempotent-Replay.description: "true" when the body is a stored replay

decision.description: Decision recorded on the event. It does not change when a review is resolved.

finalDecision.description: Effective outcome. Equals `decision` when there is no review. REVIEW while a review is pending. ALLOW after approval, BLOCK after denial or expiry.

evaluatedDecision.description: What full enforcement would have decided. Differs from `decision` in monitor mode.

review.description: Null when the event has no human review.

quotaExceeded.description: Plan quota is over the limit. The decision is still made.

sandbox.description: True when the event was created with a TEST key.

schema.description: Same action fields as POST /v1/events, plus the registered route and the path to append.

path.description: Path and query appended to the route base URL. Must start with /.

body.description: JSON value forwarded upstream when method is not GET.

review.description: Null when the event has no human review.

quotaExceeded.description: Plan quota is over the limit. The decision is still made.

upstream.description: Null when the call was not forwarded. `status` is null when the upstream call failed before a response.
